name: droidhost
description: Deploy real apps to old Android phones. One command. No root. No cloud bill.

scripts.build: bun run --cwd ../dashboard build && bun build src/main.ts --target=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/droidhost.mjs && rm -rf dist/dashboard && cp -R ../dashboard/build dist/dashboard && rm -rf dist/starters && cp -R ../starters dist/starters && rm -rf dist/starters/*/node_modules
